ghl_readback.how: Backend reads GHL API v2 contact/appointment history and injects it into the next model turn's context

api.how: We own the backend end to end; it is the API layer between the widget, the model and GHL API v2

pg_handoff.how: Backend would POST the full turn JSON (evidence, crm, answers) to PitchGenius Intelligence's ingestion API; that endpoint doesn't exist yet

human.how: A custom Conversation Provider registers the chat as a GHL conversation; a rep's reply in the GHL Unified Inbox is posted to our webhook and relayed to the visitor

ai_disclosure.how: System prompt: 'You are an AI and you say so at the start and whenever asked'; every example reply opens with 'I'm PitchGenius's AI guide.'

branding.how: Fully custom widget we build and own end to end; no third-party attribution is possible

free_test.how: Runs today against any OpenAI-compatible key, no vendor signup at all; report.md estimates ~$1-25/mo in model cost at 300 conversations/month

knowledge.how: Native 'Web Crawler' ingestion — specific URLs, directories or entire domains, plus Google Docs/PDF uploads and manual Q&A, up to 4,000 URLs per Knowledge Base.

intent.how: No native 4-state classifier; bot 'goals' are Lead Capture/Appointment Booking/General Q&A — a 4-state read needs custom prompting.

persona.how: No native persona object; the Flow-Based Builder's generic branching would be hand-modeled into personas.

questions.how: Buildable via the flow builder's branching + AI Actions, not out of the box.

capture.how: Whether Conversation AI's field-writing is constrained to verbatim visitor text (vs. paraphrase) is undocumented.

offer.how: Buildable via Workflow branching on tags/custom fields, not a preset 'recommend an offer' feature.

booking.how: Native to GHL's own calendars: GET /calendars/:calendarId/free-slots then POST /calendars/events/appointments; no native Calendly/Cal.com from inside Conversation AI.

nurture.how: Native via Workflows — a captured email/tag/field triggers a nurture Workflow directly inside GHL.

ghl_contact.how: It is the CRM itself; contacts are created/updated natively.

ghl_fields.how: Native custom-field writes on the contact record.

ghl_tags.how: POST /contacts/:contactId/tags — native tag API.

ghl_pipeline.how: Native opportunity/pipeline-stage updates on the same CRM object model.

ghl_transcript.how: POST /conversations/inbound-messages posts messages individually into an open conversation on a matching channel; no single-call transcript batch mode, and a closed thread starts a new conversation.

ghl_workflows.how: Native — Workflows trigger directly off contact tags/fields/pipeline changes inside GHL.

ghl_calendar.how: Native GHL calendar booking via the Calendars API (free-slots + create-appointment).

ghl_readback.how: Same database — native read via API v2, plus the MCP server's search_operations/describe_operation/execute_operation pattern.

api.how: Full API v2 plus an official MCP server (4-tool facade covering 550+ operations across 38 domains).

pg_handoff.how: No named PitchGenius Intelligence connector; call API v2/MCP execute_operation from a custom integration to push structured data out.

human.how: Native — Unified Inbox takeover, switching the bot's response mode off Auto-Pilot.

ai_disclosure.how: Bot goal/prompt and first-message text are fully author-controlled inside Conversation AI setup; write the AI disclosure into it.

branding.how: Whether 'Powered by HighLevel' branding appears on the widget at any tier, and how to remove it, is not stated in any page retrieved.

free_test.how: No dedicated free tier for AI Employee (Conversation AI/Voice AI); the platform's 14-day trial covers the base CRM only. Pay-Per-Use (no monthly fee, metered per token) is the cheapest live test, not a stated free plan.

knowledge.how: Enter a URL at setup to auto-analyze + seed the Knowledge Library; supports web-page scraping with recurring re-scrape.

intent.how: Custom Scenario nodes can detect an intent (e.g. booking intent), but no preset 4-state classifier confirmed.

persona.how: 'Persona Settings' in CloseBot controls the agent's own tone/voice, not visitor-type detection; classifying the visitor needs a custom Objective + Custom Scenario branch.

questions.how: Job Flow branching (Agent Nodes with exit-tag rules + Custom Scenarios) runs a different Objective sequence per branch.

capture.how: Objectives write the collected answer straight to a GoHighLevel custom field via a PUT request once the objective completes.

offer.how: Same Job Flow branching (Custom Scenario + Statement action) presents a different offer per branch.

booking.how: Booking action checks GHL calendar availability and books the appointment in real time.

nurture.how: Objective captures the email into a GHL field; the Modify Tags action fires a GHL nurture workflow directly (documented 'ready-to-book'/'dnd' tag pattern).

ghl_contact.how: Native OAuth 'click to connect' to a GoHighLevel sub-account; writes the contact via the GHL API.

ghl_fields.how: Objective completion triggers a PUT request to the GoHighLevel contact custom-field endpoint; unlimited fields, even on the free plan.

ghl_tags.how: 'Modify Tags' action adds/removes GHL tags (auto-lowercased to match GHL/LeadConnector rules).

ghl_pipeline.how: Modify Tags pairs with a GHL workflow (tag-triggered) to move the pipeline stage — the vendor's own documented pattern.

ghl_transcript.how: Messages run through the GHL Conversations channel itself, so the transcript sits on the contact by default; usage is even billed per transcript.

ghl_workflows.how: Documented pattern: a 'ready-to-book' tag fires the scheduling workflow, a 'lead-qualified' tag hands off to a rep, a 'dnd' tag stops the bot.

ghl_calendar.how: Booking action reads a GHL Calendar ID (from the connected sub-account) and books directly.

ghl_readback.how: Source Filters read GHL tag/list state to decide whether the agent is ON or OFF for a given contact.

api.how: Custom Webhook action (any URL, JSON/Form Data, custom headers) plus CloseBot's own REST API (api.closebot.com, X-CB-KEY header).

pg_handoff.how: Custom Webhook action would POST the Job Flow's captured variables to PitchGenius Intelligence's endpoint.

human.how: 'Stop Responding' action pauses the AI on one conversation for a human to take over without killing the agent elsewhere.

ai_disclosure.how: Statement/Objective node text is fully author-controlled, so the opening line can state it is an AI.

branding.how: 'Fully white-label' / white-label client portal is an Agency-plan feature ($397/mo).

free_test.how: Free plan, $0/mo, 100 messages/mo cap, 1 seat.
